fields.label: Story opening
fields.value: Tom Weinberger opened a chicken-parts shop in Homewood, Illinois, in 1952. After learning the deli trade at Ray Markon’s Seaway Deli, he grew Tom’s Delis to five Chicagoland shops. Dan worked weekends and summers as a kid, studied sandwich making around the country, and opened Weinberger’s Deli in Grapevine in 2002.

fields.label: Dan’s quote
fields.value: “All Chefs have passion for some part of the Culinary experience. Mine just happens to be the sandwich.”

fields.label: Story closing
fields.value: The menu keeps moving, including a spring sandwich contest built around customer ideas. Want a change? Ask the sandwich maker. If something is not right, tell the team so they can address it.
